articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex turns flat after positive start; Nifty trades above 25,800 amid tariff concerns
articles.summary: Rupee depreciated 20 paise to 92.40 against the US dollar in early trade on Thursday, as higher crude oil prices and the US administration's proposed tariff hikes against India fuelled dollar demand and weighed on the local unit. Foreign fund inflows favoured the Indian currency, but it faced pressure after crude oil prices reversed easing, hovering above the USD 95-per-barrel level, according to forex traders.

articles.title: India steps up push to take higher education global; 21 foreign universities now operational in country
articles.summary: Union Minister for Education Pralhad Joshi chaired a meeting with key officials to discuss educational internationalisation. The Ministry aims to expand the Indian Knowledge System's global reach through various initiatives and partnerships.

articles.title: Indian students choosing UK master's courses for jobs, not just degrees: AI course interest rises 43% as employability drives study abroad decisions
articles.summary: Indian students are increasingly choosing UK master's programmes based on employment prospects, with interest in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning courses rising 42.6% year-on-year, according to LeapScholar's UK Study-to-Work Report 2026. Based on over 6,400 counselling conversations, the report highlights growing demand for technology courses, concerns about salaries and education costs, and a gap in awareness about employer sponsorship.

articles.title: NTA recruitment 2026: Applications invited for 15 Office Assistant posts; check eligibility and how to apply
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency is inviting applications for 15 Office Assistant posts on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates must have a graduate degree, along with relevant computer and communication skills.

articles.title: US green card process may get tougher for Indian workers as Labor Department releases revised PERM form ahead of overhaul: What F-1 OPT and H-1B graduates must knoww
articles.summary: The US Department of Labor has published a revised draft of Form ETA-9089, proposing changes to the PERM employment-based green card process. The draft requires employers to submit recruitment records upfront, expands layoff disclosures from six months to two years and makes Appendix E mandatory.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 22 (LIVE)

articles.title: 'O.M' BO Day 7 [Live]: Dhanush's film surpasses Rs 66 crore net in India
articles.summary: 'O.M: Operation Mole' has experienced a decline in box office earnings following an exceptional opening weekend. After its first week in theaters, the film's net collection in India reached Rs 66.27 crore.

articles.title: 'Doomsday' tracking USD 270 million debut
